extraction.NOTES: Lot 1 and South half of Northeast quarter of section 4, and Southwest quarter of Northwest quarter section 3, township 44, north of range 32. Receipt for patent signed by the allottee April 3, 1920. On August 7, 1920, Peter Larvie mortgaged the land to Petters and Co. for $800. There is also a second mortgage for $231.46 to be paid in annual installments and completed by November 1, 1927. This mortgage is dated August [date not fully legible]. On May 10, 1924, the Sheriff foreclosed the mortgage and on May 11, 1925, sheriff's deed was given for the land to August Gertenbaugh, assignee of Petters & Company.
